verdict.rationale: Built-in physics is a fair axis for a game engine, but nothing in the evidence pack documents rigid bodies, collision detection, or raycasting in Unreal Engine. The pack covers Blueprints, C++, Python scripting, plugins, asset management, cooking, networking and Remote Control instead. The one community remark about physics inaccuracies in a demo ponytail neither establishes nor contradicts out-of-the-box rigid-body, collision or raycast support, so absence of evidence yields "none".
